## v0.2.4
### UI/UX Refinements - **Unified Carousel Transitions**: Wrapped the welcome screen tutorial preview carousel in a single transitioning block with spring curves, eliminating conflicting animations and layout stutter. - **Optimized Tutorial Coach**: Rewrote the active tutorial coach overlay to use a single spring animation and unified shadow. Removed redundant colored shadows and container hover scale modifiers, preventing layout thrashing and making tutorial navigation extremely fluid. - **Aligned Hover Glows**: Aligned the sidebar recent file row hover glow corner radius to match the button background (12pt), resolving overlapping rounded borders.
### Navigation and macOS Integration - **Horizontal Wheel Navigation**: Horizontal mouse wheels and trackpad left/right gestures now move across VisiData columns, matching the existing vertical scroll behavior for rows. - **Menu Bar Access**: iData now shows a menu bar item by default, with quick actions for showing the main window, opening a file, preferences, update checks, and quit. - **Optional Dock Hiding**: Added a preference to hide the Dock icon while keeping the menu bar item available so the app remains easy to reopen.
